McKechnie’s Farewell, X:7 - an alternative solution for flute players.

This tune was written in D Major. There a few notes in bars 7 and 8, 15 and 16 etc that go below the compass of the flute.
I note that versions #3 and #5 put those phrases up an Octave, a very acceptable solution. Another is to play the tune in A major. Hence this version #7. It is Donald K’s version transposed up.

↳ Posted by Philip W on September 30th, 2020.
